including our parishioners, family members, neighbours, friends and all who have no one to remember them. eternal rest grant unto them, o lord, let perpetual light shine upon them. may their souls and all the souls of the faithful departed, through the mercy of god, rest in peace. amen. november the month of holy souls “it is a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead that they may be loosed form their sins.” each november, the church engages in a great crusade of prayer for our dead. we pray for our dead because we believe there is a communion - an unbreakable link - between the living and the dead. that link ensures us that we can help them and they can help us. one saint said that the holy souls may win astounding favours for us and deliver us from evils, sickness and dangers of every kind. our prayer, especially the holy sacrifice of the mass, is the greatest expression of our gratitude and love for those who have died. in fact, the november novena of masses is the most powerful way to honour with great respect the memory of our dead. kilmacow parish priest: fr. martin tobin adm weekend masses : mobile:
